title: Stop construction work spreading lead paint dust

paragraphs: Make a complaint to the Department of Building Inspection
Construction work that disturbs paint may contaminate your home with lead dust. By law, the dust must be contained. If it is not, take the following steps immediately to prevent lead poisoning.

sections.heading: Check for possible violations
paragraphs: Check the Department of Building Inspection rules for working safely with lead paint.

sections.heading: Get help to ensure rules are followed
paragraphs: Ask the Department of Building Inspection for an inspection to identify and stop any violations.
Note: You must have the address of the building where the construction work is occurring.

sections.heading: Track the complaint
paragraphs: Follow the progress of your complaint or find out the inspector who has been assigned to evaluate your complaint.
